identity.title: Emergence of meta-stable clustering in mean-field transformer models

problem.claim: Characterize the long-term evolution, meta-stable phases, and clustering of tokens in a mean-field Transformer model.

contributions.claim: A perturbative analysis of the mean-field PDE around iid uniform initialization.
A large-token result showing closeness to a structured meta-stable solution manifold, including periodic structures.
An explicit identification of the manifold’s structure through the index maximizing a rescaled Gegenbauer polynomial, parameterized by inverse temperature.

stated_novelty.claim: The paper presents a mathematical investigation focused on the emergence and persistence of meta-stable phases and clustering in this system.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report that, as the number of tokens becomes large, the model remains close to a meta-stable manifold around iid uniform initialization.
The authors report that the manifold’s structure is determined explicitly by an index maximizing a rescaled Gegenbauer polynomial as a function of inverse temperature.

narrative_sequence.summary: Tokens across Transformer layers are modeled as a continuous-time spherical flow governed by a mean-field interacting particle system.
The corresponding Wasserstein-gradient-flow PDE is studied for long-term meta-stability and clustering behavior.
Perturbation around iid uniform initialization yields large-token closeness to a structured meta-stable manifold.
The manifold structure is linked explicitly to an inverse-temperature-dependent Gegenbauer-polynomial index.

source_observation.claim: The abstract pairs a perturbative regime—around iid uniform initialization—with a precise parameter-dependent structural characterization.

lessons.interpretation: This links where the analysis is anchored to how the resulting states are classified.
lessons.application: When presenting a theoretical dynamics result, state both the reference configuration for the analysis and the explicit rule that identifies the resulting structure.
lessons.exception: This framing may be unsuitable when the result is not local to a reference state or lacks an interpretable parameterization.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the quantitative meaning of “remains close,” the time horizon, or the assumptions required for the large-token limit.
It does not report empirical experiments, numerical details, or comparisons with alternative analyses.
